description.narrative: An integrated training package on IYCF counselling and CMAM was rolled out to facilitate expansion of the nutrition-specific intervention service delivery network. In total, 600 doctors were trained on this package, which focuses on inpatient and outpatient treatment of wasted children and promotion of optimum IYCF practices. | Status:Met | As-of Date:09/01/2017

title.narrative: 6.2.a. Number of counties able to implement behavior change communication on IYCF

actual.value: 2016:30 counties reached. The programme facilitated a total of nine workshops on IYCF and CMAM: three in Pyongyang for district general hospitals, two in Kaesong for provincial and district hospitals, plus one in Nampo and three in the northern provinces for the first time since 2008.
